integrity: A complete proof and standalone finite checker are included. Finite checks corroborate, but the all-parameter theorem is derived mathematically; no external certification or authorship claim.
limitations: Only nonadaptive coordinate-equality VC shattering is proved. No result about Littlestone dimension or full integral homology. Prior partial-parking counting formulas are credited; independent audit remains outstanding.
title: Parking-preference shattering is exactly partial parking: a pure nonmatroidal complex
